build_dinov2_vitl14_model: build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 vision transformer model pretrained on LVD-142M dataset
build_dinov2_vitg14_model: build a DINOv2 ViT-g/14 model with swiglufused FFN layer pretrained on LVD-142M
build_dinov2_vitl14_reg_model: build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 model with 4 register tokens and antialias interpolation
build_custom_dinov2_model: build a custom DINOv2 model with configurable arch, patch size, and image size via _make_dinov2_model
build_unpretrained_dinov2_model: build a DINOv2 ViT-B/14 model without pretrained weights by setting pretrained to False
